## zipzi.values.ObservationTexturePolicy

```python
class ObservationTexturePolicy(Value)
```

Explicit base-level texture policy. Budgets count logical straight RGBA8
bytes per referenced asset ID, independently of physical buffer sharing.

Variants: [ObservationTexturePolicyOriginal](values-sampling.md#zipzi-values-observationtexturepolicyoriginal), [ObservationTexturePolicyFitBudget](values-sampling.md#zipzi-values-observationtexturepolicyfitbudget)

## zipzi.values.SampleInputAnimation

```python
class SampleInputAnimation(SampleInput)
```

Combined playback sampled by canonical 60 Hz replay, including scheduled activations,
fades and optional physics. This is not stateless raw-clip curve sampling.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `times` | `tuple[float, ...]` | Required | Ordered requested times in seconds on the preview timeline. Seeks to times at least<br>1/60 second replay from that first update; sampling zero does not seed later replay. |
| `motions` | `tuple[tuple[str, float], ...]` | `[]` | Motion clip ID and activation time in seconds; the second value is not a weight.<br>A clip starts on the first replay update at or after activation. A clip activated at<br>zero therefore has local time max(0, requested_time - 1/60) in its first cycle.<br>Inspect each result's motion_positions.local_time for the evaluated curve coordinate. |
| `expressions` | `tuple[tuple[str, float], ...]` | `[]` | Expression ID and activation time in seconds on the same preview timeline. |
| `inputs` | `tuple[ParameterActivation, ...]` | `[]` |  |
| `physics` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `stabilized_start` | `bool` | `false` |  |

Related: [zipzi.values.ParameterActivation](values-sampling.md#zipzi-values-parameteractivation), [zipzi.values.SampleInput](values-sampling.md#zipzi-values-sampleinput)

## zipzi.values.TopologyOverlay

```python
class TopologyOverlay(Value)
```

Explicit diagnostic drawing options; overlays ignore masks and occlusion.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targets` | `tuple[common.ObjectTarget, ...] \| None` | `null` (`None`) | Diagnostic selection only; the textured context image is unchanged. None selects all<br>meshes, an empty selection selects none. Mesh/Part targets are unioned and deduplicated;<br>Parts include nested Parts. Missing targets fail explicitly. Maximum 256 selectors. |
| `wireframe` | `bool` | `true` | Draw triangle edges in cyan, in final evaluated model coordinates. |
| `vertices` | `bool` | `false` | Draw vertex positions as yellow dots. |
| `vertex_ids` | `bool` | `false` | Draw stable authoring vertex IDs in yellow, rather than transient array offsets. |
| `constraints` | `bool` | `false` | Draw meshing boundary edges in green and internal constraints in magenta. |
| `strain` | `bool` | `false` | Fill triangles by symmetric edge stretch relative to the default pose: blue=1,<br>orange=2, red>=4; flipped or collapsed triangles are magenta. |
| `include_hidden` | `bool` | `false` | Include disabled, hidden and zero-opacity meshes. Default draws visible meshes only. |
| `topology_only` | `bool` | `false` | Clear the textured image before diagnostic drawing, retaining the exact same view. |
| `heat_opacity` | `float` | `0.25` | Heat fill opacity in [0,1]. Applied once per pixel using the most severe overlapping<br>triangle, so overlapping layers cannot accumulate opacity. Lines and labels stay opaque. |
| `anomalies_only` | `bool` | `false` | Restrict every diagnostic layer to anomalous triangles and their incident vertices/edges.<br>Degenerate, flipped and undefined-reference triangles always count as anomalies. |
| `thresholds` | `TopologyThresholds` | `{"max_aspect_ratio": 20.0, "max_edge_stretch": 2.0, "min_angle_degrees": 10.0}` | Thresholds used by anomalies_only; reports themselves are never threshold-filtered. |
| `label_scale` | `int` | `2` | Decimal glyph scale in output pixels, 1..4. Labels avoid other labels globally;<br>an ID is omitted when no nearby in-view position has enough space. |
| `label_spacing` | `int` | `3` | Minimum clear gap between label rectangles in pixels, 0..32. |
| `max_labels` | `int` | `256` | Maximum labels per image, 0..4096. Vertex dots remain independent of this limit. |

## zipzi.values.TopologyThresholds

```python
class TopologyThresholds(Value)
```

Advisory anomaly thresholds in evaluated model space, relative to the default pose.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_angle_degrees` | `float` | `10.0` | An angle below this value is anomalous; finite degrees in [0,60]. Default 10. |
| `max_aspect_ratio` | `float` | `20.0` | A longest-edge/altitude ratio above this is anomalous; finite and >= 1. Default 20. |
| `max_edge_stretch` | `float` | `2.0` | A symmetric edge-length ratio above this is anomalous; finite and >= 1. Default 2. |
